title: The Abandoned Delve
objective: Loot the old dungeon under the ruined keep and get out alive, by the gate or the shaft.

alarm.text: Your noise carries through the crypts. Somewhere ahead, boots crunch over bone toward the shaft.

rooms.name: Broken Gate
rooms.description: A cracked stair runs down from the ruined keep to a gate hanging off its hinges. Daylight is at your back. Someone has chalked marks on the gatepost.

features.name: Chalk Marks
features.description: Faded chalk marks left by an earlier treasure-hunter, and a fresher line beneath them.
features.discovery: The marks read: "Dead man in the guard post. Wire on the shrine stair. Key on the altar opens the vault. Webs: keep out." Under them, in new chalk: "M.C. went down the shaft — mine."

rooms.name: Gate Hall
rooms.description: A long hall of fallen banners. A swollen door stands shut in one wall, bones clatter somewhere behind the barracks arch, and a passage leads to the guard post. A porter's door stands at the near end, and daylight falls through a rubble-strewn arch at the far end.

rooms.name: Guard Post
rooms.description: A cramped guard room with a weapon rack and an overturned table. A dead guard still stands its post. A narrow way leads on to an old well.

features.name: Weapon Rack
features.description: A rack of rusted spears.
features.discovery: Tucked behind the spears is a stoppered vial of red liquid.

features.name: Overturned Table
features.description: A heavy table knocked onto its side, dice scattered beneath it.
features.discovery: Among the scattered dice lies a leather purse, dropped by the guard when it fell to its last game.

items.name: Potion of Healing
items.description: A stoppered vial of red liquid that glimmers when shaken.

items.name: Guard's Purse
items.description: A leather purse of old silver coins, the guard's stake.

rooms.name: Barracks
rooms.description: Rows of collapsed bunks. Two skeletons in rusted mail stand guard here still, beside a footlocker at the end of the room.

features.name: Footlocker
features.description: An iron-bound footlocker, its lid rusted half open.
features.discovery: Wrapped in a mouldy cloak is a dagger hilt chased with silver.

items.name: Dagger Hilt
items.description: A dagger hilt chased with silver, its blade long gone.

rooms.name: Storeroom
rooms.description: A dry storeroom of split barrels and empty shelves. One old barrel is still sealed.

features.name: Old Barrel
features.description: One barrel is still sealed.
features.discovery: Packed in straw inside the barrel are a stoppered vial of red liquid, an oiled shortsword and a shield.

items.name: Potion of Healing
items.description: A stoppered vial of red liquid that glimmers when shaken.

items.name: Oiled Shortsword
items.description: A plain shortsword wrapped in oilcloth, its edge still keen.

items.name: Storeroom Shield
items.description: A wooden shield rimmed with iron, packed away and never used.

rooms.name: Dry Well
rooms.description: A round chamber around a dry well under a rotted windlass, where a scrawny goblin chatters at anyone who comes near. A stair leads down to a shrine, and a webbed passage to a crypt.

features.name: Well Head
features.description: A ring of worn stone over the dry shaft. Far below, a goblin squints up at you, and a low arch opens off the bottom.

changed.description: Your rope hangs from the windlass down into the well, knotted fast. It would take your weight to the bottom.

uses.text: You knot the rope to the windlass and pay it down. The goblin swarms up it before you've finished, and sits panting on the rim, grinning at you.

features.name: Windlass
features.description: An oak windlass over the well. Its rope rotted away long ago, but the axle still turns.

creatures.name: Goblin
creatures.description: A scrawny goblin, grey with well silt, who is too frightened of the dead to go anywhere alone.

topics.name: the vault
topics.reply: "The dead never left. Bones in the barracks, a big spider in the crypt, and a dead thing in the vault past the shaft. The vault key? On the altar in the shrine."

topics.name: the stair
topics.reply: "Fine, fine. There's a loose step on the shrine stair. Step on it and the stair drops you. Look before you walk."
topics.failure: "Get me out first, then I'll tell you things." The goblin sulks.

topics.name: the woman
topics.reply: "One came down the shaft rope yesterday. Mags, she called herself. She's in the bone room with a hammer, taking teeth. Loud, and she'll run if she hears you."

topics.name: the tomb
topics.reply: "The old lord's box opens if you press the carved hand on its side. Don't tell the dead I said."

rooms.name: Porter's Lodge
rooms.description: A narrow lodge beside the gate hall, dry and lit by a stub of candle. Its door has a stout bar on the inside, and a cot stands under a row of pegs.

features.name: Peg Rail
features.description: A rail of wooden pegs, hung with a porter's cloak gone stiff with age.
features.discovery: Under the cloak hangs a coil of good hemp rope.

features.name: Porter's Cot
features.description: A narrow cot with a straw mattress. It would do for a night.

features.name: Key Board
features.description: A board of iron hooks, every one empty. A label under the largest reads "vault".

items.name: Coil of Rope
items.description: Fifty feet of hemp rope, dry and strong.

creatures.name: Hedda the Pedlar
creatures.description: A wiry pedlar camped by the cot, with a pack of goods to sell and a purse for whatever comes up out of the dark.

topics.name: the keep
topics.reply: "Nobody's held this keep since the old lord was laid under it, and the dead down there never heard he'd gone. Bring me what you find. I pay fair for stones and trinkets."

topics.name: the way down
topics.reply: "Most go down the shrine stair, past the dry well. There's a goblin stuck in that well, whining. A rope would fetch him up, and maybe show you where he got in."

rooms.name: Fallen Kitchen
rooms.description: Half the kitchen roof has fallen in, and grey daylight shows through the hole. Something has made a den in the rubble by the hearth, and the floor is littered with bones.

features.name: Hearth
features.description: A wide hearth, cold for years, with a spit still across it.

features.name: Bone Heap
features.description: Gnawed bones heaped against the wall, sheep's and deer's and one that might be a man's.
features.discovery: Among the bones is a traveller's rotted belt, its purse still full of gold, and a green stone with moss-like threads inside it.

features.name: Roof Hole
features.description: A hole in the roof, open to the sky. It's too high to climb.

items.name: Traveller's Purse
items.description: A rotted leather purse of gold coins.

items.name: Moss Agate
items.description: A pale green agate threaded with dark green, like moss under ice.

rooms.name: Shrine
rooms.description: A small, quiet shrine at the foot of the stair. Silver candlesticks stand on a stone altar beside an offering box, and a lamp still hangs over them. A passage runs on to a shaft of daylight.

features.name: Altar
features.description: A stone altar with two tarnished silver candlesticks.
features.discovery: Behind the candlesticks lies a heavy bronze key.

features.name: Offering Box
features.description: A small oak box at the altar's foot, its lid carved with an open hand.
features.discovery: Inside lies a roll of parchment, sealed with the shrine's open hand.

features.name: Shrine Lamp
features.description: A bronze lamp on a chain. The dead have never come in here, and the air is calm.

items.name: Bronze Key
items.description: A heavy bronze key stamped with a lord's crest.

items.name: Candlesticks
items.description: A pair of tarnished silver candlesticks.

items.name: Sealed Parchment
items.description: A roll of parchment sealed with an open hand.

rooms.name: Web Crypt
rooms.description: Thick webs fill a low crypt. A cocooned body hangs in the middle, and something large shifts in the dark above it.

features.name: Cocoon
features.description: A body wrapped in web, hanging from the ceiling.
features.discovery: On the dead treasure-hunter's hand is a gold ring.

items.name: Gold Ring
items.description: A heavy gold ring set with a red stone.

rooms.name: Shaft Bottom
rooms.description: The bottom of a collapsed shaft, lit by daylight far above. A knotted rope hangs down: you could climb out with what you carry. Beside it a bronze door leads to the vault, and a passage lined with bones leads away into the dark.

features.name: Knotted Rope
features.description: A knotted rope, tied off somewhere far above.
features.discovery: The rope is sound. It would take your weight to the surface.

rooms.name: Vault
rooms.description: The lord's vault: a stone room with an iron chest against the far wall and a tall stack of coffers on a shelf above it. Something that was once a man crouches over the chest.

features.name: Iron Chest
features.description: A great iron chest, its lid broken open.
features.discovery: The chest is still half full of old gold coins. A jewelled goblet lies on top of them, and a dark red stone has rolled into one corner.

features.name: Coffer Stack
features.description: Iron-bound coffers stacked high on a sagging shelf. One good heave would bring them all down.

success.text: The shelf gives way, and the coffers come crashing down on your foe.

success-by-5.text: The whole stack comes down on your foe and knocks it flat.

items.name: Gold Coins
items.description: Handfuls of old gold coins stamped with a forgotten lord's face.

items.name: Goblet
items.description: A jewelled gold goblet, its rim gnawed by something's teeth.

items.name: Garnet
items.description: A dark red garnet the size of a thumbnail.

rooms.name: Well Bottom
rooms.description: The dry bottom of the well, a round pit of silt with a coin of daylight far above. A goblin has made a nest here, and a low arch leads on into the dark.

features.name: Silted Floor
features.description: Dry grey silt. Coins glint in it here and there.
features.discovery: Generations of wishes: a scatter of coins, green and worn, but still good.

features.name: Goblin's Nest
features.description: A heap of rags and rat bones where the goblin slept. It smells as bad as it looks.

features.name: Low Arch
features.description: A low arch of old brick, leading down. You hear water dripping beyond it.

items.name: Wishing Coins
items.description: A scatter of old coins, worn smooth.

rooms.name: Flooded Cistern
rooms.description: Steps run down into a vaulted cistern, flooded to the third step with black, still water. A walkway runs round its edge to an arch at the far side.

features.name: Black Water
features.description: Cold, still water. You can't see the bottom, and you'd rather not.

features.name: Drowned Delver
features.description: A body in a delver's coat lies face down on the walkway, a pack still on its back.
features.discovery: In the pack, wrapped in a wet stocking, is a red-brown jasper.

features.name: Cistern Steps
features.description: Worn steps going down into the water. The lowest are green and slick.

items.name: Jasper
items.description: A polished red-brown jasper, cold from the water.

rooms.name: Ossuary
rooms.description: Skulls line every wall of a long vault, row on row, and the floor crunches with small bones. Someone has been at work here: skulls lie knocked from their rows, and a satchel lies dropped among them.

features.name: Skull Wall
features.description: Hundreds of skulls, set in rows by the keep's long-dead masons. Many have been knocked about, their teeth pried out.

features.name: Mags's Satchel
features.description: A battered leather satchel, heavy and rattling.
features.discovery: Inside are a handful of gold teeth and coins, and a blue-green stone wrapped in a rag.

features.name: Bone Passage
features.description: A passage lined with bones runs toward a glimmer of daylight. Another arch leads on to a tomb.

items.name: Mags's Takings
items.description: Gold teeth and old coins, worth a fair few gold pieces.

items.name: Turquoise
items.description: A blue-green turquoise, veined with brown.

items.name: Mags Corrow's Coins
items.description: A small pouch of silver pieces.

rooms.name: Lord's Tomb
rooms.description: A cold, high tomb. A stone effigy of the old lord lies on a great sarcophagus, his hands folded on his sword, and faded banners hang above him.

features.name: Sarcophagus Lid
features.description: A heavy stone lid, carved with the old lord's arms. A carved hand on its side is worn smooth.
features.discovery: Inside, the old lord's bones wear a silver death mask, and a green stone rests on his breastbone.

failure-by-5.text: The lid slips and crashes back down.

success-by-5.text: The lid grinds aside, and with it out of the way you can read the inscription cut under the effigy's feet, where only the dead would see it: "I kept the keep. Let it keep me."

features.name: Effigy
features.description: A stone lord, stern and long-nosed, his sword on his breast. Someone has chipped the gilt from his crown.

features.name: Faded Banners
features.description: Banners so faded their arms can hardly be read. They stir in a draught from the ossuary.

items.name: Silver Death Mask
items.description: A thin silver mask of the old lord's face, tarnished black.

items.name: Peridot
items.description: A clear olive-green peridot.

passages.description: A short passage to the guard post.
An arch. Bones clatter beyond it.

door.name: Swollen Door
door.description: The damp wood has swollen tight in its frame.

passages.description: The porter's door, its bar hanging loose.
A rubble-strewn arch toward daylight. Something growls beyond it.
A narrow way to the well.
A worn stair down to the shrine.

trap.name: Loose Step
trap.description: One step is set loose over a drop, wired to give way.
trap.trigger: A step gives way and the stair drops you down onto broken stone.

passages.description: Your rope, down the well shaft.
A passage choked with webs. Something big lives in there.
A gap torn through the webs.

door.name: Vault Door
door.description: A bronze door stamped with a lord's crest, locked fast.

failure-by-5.text: The bronze rings like a bell, and the echo rolls away through the crypts.

passages.description: The low arch, down a few wet steps.
The walkway round the cistern, to an arch. Something taps beyond it.
A carved arch, its keystone a crowned skull.

opponents.description: The dead guard turns, jaw hanging, and shambles at you.

opponents.name: Tall Skeleton
opponents.description: A tall skeleton in rusted mail raises a shortsword.

opponents.name: Bent Skeleton
opponents.description: A bent skeleton clatters up from a bunk beside it.

opponents.name: Grey Wolf
opponents.description: A lean grey wolf rises from its den in the rubble, hackles up, and comes at you low.
A spider the size of a pony drops from the webs, fangs dripping.
The ghoul looks up from the chest, a jewelled goblet in its claws, and springs.

opponents.name: Mags Corrow
opponents.description: A wiry woman in a dusty coat drops her hammer, snatches up a scimitar and snarls. "Find your own dead."

opponents.name: Dead Delver
opponents.description: A dead treasure-hunter in a mouldering coat shuffles out of the dark, still clutching an empty sack.

endings.title: Out with the loot
endings.text: You climb back into the daylight with the dungeon's treasure on your back.

endings.title: Out empty-handed
endings.text: You climb back into the daylight alive, with nothing to show for it.

endings.title: Lost in the delve
endings.text: You fall in the dark under the ruined keep, and the dead keep you. Your adventuring ends here.
